description: This file declares functions and structures related to memory allocation for repository objects in a version control system, including nodes for blobs, trees, commits, tags, and the overall allocation state.

methods.name: alloc_blob_node
methods.description: Allocates memory for a blob object node within a repository.

methods.name: alloc_tree_node
methods.description: Allocates memory for a tree object node within a repository.

methods.name: alloc_commit_node
methods.description: Allocates memory for a commit object node within a repository.

methods.name: alloc_tag_node
methods.description: Allocates memory for a tag object node within a repository.

methods.name: alloc_object_node
methods.description: Allocates memory for a generic object node within a repository.

methods.name: alloc_state_alloc
methods.description: Creates a new allocation state structure.

methods.name: alloc_state_free_and_null
methods.description: Frees an allocation state and sets its pointer to null.
